thread:
maya: starting a staggered cascade shift for edge route e42 -> router-v2 in eu-west1. change window 14:00-15:00 UTC. keeping 10% reserve for rollback.
liam: ack. which session affinity are we preserving?
maya: we keep cookie-stickiness, pinning session-token header. will pin newsvc:2024-11-01 to route during canary.
maya: plan: 0->5->20->50->100 over 40m with 5m probes between steps. pause at 20 for quality check.
deploy-bot: Rollout requested by maya for service newsvc:2024-11-01 -> initiating staged traffic shift. run_id=rl-3157.
deploy-bot: step 1 -> set weight 5% to router-v2 in eu-west1. command: `rbctl traffic-set --route e42 --target router-v2 --weight 5 --region eu-west1 --run rl-3157`
liam: i pushed the probe queryset to canary-suite (links: https://ci.internal/canary/rl-3157). latency thresholds: p95 < 220ms, error rate < 0.5%.
nora: watching logs, tailing ingress: `kubectl -n edge logs -l route=e42 -f`
ops-oncall: FYI I'll be on-call for the window — will signal if any infra alarms hit. set alert thresholds for 10% p95 bump.
sasha: double-checking fallback routes and warm pools. if router-v2 has OOM, we fallback to router-v1 via lb-fallback policy.
maya: note: kv-cache priming is part of rollout step 2. warming allowed for 3 minutes, then we start step 2.
deploy-bot: step 2 complete -> weight 20%. run rl-3157 progress: 2/5.
liam: at 20% p50 stable, p95 +15ms but within limit. one minor 429 spike (10m avg) traced to auth-rate limiter on canary instances.
sasha: applying conservative token-bucket bump on canary: `auth-config --service newsvc --burst 50 --rate 100/s`
maya: holding at 20% for quality check now. Signal if you see user-visible regressions.
ops-oncall: infra alarms clear. no error-rate increase.
liam: can we run a targeted regression eval against the saved prompt set? small batch now.
maya: go for it. label results with rl-3157.
deploy-bot: manual approval required to proceed to 50% — react with :thumbsup: to confirm.
nora: :thumbsup: good from prod-telemetry (LLM outputs look equivalent).
liam: +1 from perf.
sasha: +1 from infra (warm pools healthy).
maya: proceeding to 50%.
deploy-bot: step 3 -> set weight 50%. run rl-3157 progress: 3/5.
ops-oncall: small p95 blip at minute 2 after shift, auto-corrected as instance pool scaled. no rollback.
liam: rolling logs show a few 502s from a single AZ, routing adjusted to avoid that AZ.
maya: we have a decision point: if 502s persist beyond 5m we rollback. otherwise continue.
deploy-bot: step 4 -> set weight 100%. run rl-3157 progress: 5/5. completing final checks.
maya: final check passed. note pinned version newsvc:2024-11-01 is now live. documented release notes: short description, kv-cache priming, affinity preserved, auth-rate bump.
liam: I'll open a follow-up PR to the release notes doc with perf graphs.
sasha: removed canary warmers after 10m stable.
ora: thumbs: :tada: nice and smooth.
ops-oncall: closing watch window in 15m if no regressions.
maya: thanks team. we kept rollback plan ready (`rbctl rollback --run rl-3157 --target router-v1`) but not needed.
liam: one postmortem note: add automated detection for auth limiter spikes during canary.
maya: filed issue #2345 to track automation.
deploy-bot: Run rl-3157 closed as SUCCESS at 1748500360.
